summary: 대학일자리플러스센터에서 2026년 하반기 포스코이앤씨 멘토링 Day 프로그램을 시행함

en.title: [University Job Plus Center] Notice on the 2026 2nd Half POSCO E&C Mentoring Day Program
summary: The University Job Plus Center (대학일자리플러스센터) is hosting the 2026 2nd Half POSCO E&C Mentoring Day Program.

Applicants can apply even if their major is different from the mentor's field, and up to 2 mentors can be selected per person (mentor assignments may be randomly adjusted depending on application status).
Applications are submitted online via the provided link (http://job.inha.ac.kr?eAXcvqX).
The application deadline is Tuesday, October 27, at 10:00 AM.
en.easyExplanation: This is the 2026 Fall POSCO E&C Mentoring Day program organized by the University Job Plus Center. You can apply even if your major differs from the mentor's field, and you can request up to two mentors. Interested students must apply through the online link by Tuesday, October 27, at 10:00 AM.
en.target: Students may apply even if their major field differs from the mentor's (detailed eligibility criteria not specified in the text)
